status: FROZEN before any H1-PA training or evaluation: no H1-PA model exists, so no result has been seen. Committed in git; h1pa_statistics.decide refuses to run when the rule's bytes differ from bound_sha256
decided_by: maintainer, 2026-10-24 (H1-PA final training readiness: freeze the formal decision rules before formal training or evaluation)

arms.PCA-Original: E1's two 2.96M PCA checkpoints, re-evaluated only
arms.D4-Original: D4 Top-1 trained under E1's recipe on E1's pack, two seeds
arms.D4-Augmented: D4 Top-1 trained under E1's recipe on E1's pack + the whole-unit fluid increment, two seeds

seed_pairing: a comparison pairs its arms by training-seed number (PCA-Original's E1 seeds are the same numbers); every directional label needs both seeds' own estimates on its side

comparison_meaning.A: the initialization effect: data, packing, recipe, seeds and evaluation identical
comparison_meaning.B: the effect of adding the fluid increment WITH the 786 extra optimizer steps and 1.27x FLOPs it brings; never the data content's isolated causal effect
comparison_meaning.C: end to end; descriptive only (estimate, interval, per-seed estimates, rates); no label is assigned or cited

multiplicity: A and B are separate questions, each decided at its own 95% interval and never combined into one claim; within a decided comparison the four static-axis contrasts are a Holm family at alpha 0.05 (h1_statistics); every other unit is reported with its own estimate and labelled descriptive

set.validity_mask: v1 (6 items excluded; formal 714 = 570 static + 144 interactive)
set.scoring_protocol: each component's scorer.formal_protocol (v2 for eval-set-1), unchanged
set.action_protocol: v2 (the protocol the interactive episodes are generated and replayed under)
set.every_item: every item of every unit is generated for every checkpoint; the validity mask and core decide which rows enter the formal numbers

seed_rule.namespace: the evaluated unit's key <component>__<unit> (e.g. fluid_reasoning_720__dev_v1, stage3_capability_846__gsm8k): uncapped_eval reads it from the prompt file's stem, which dose_driver.evaluate_all stages as <component>__<unit>.jsonl; run_battery takes it as --seed-namespace
seed_rule.independent_of: the model, the arm and the training seed: every checkpoint draws with the same seed for the same item, turn and sample

decoding.binding: the driver passes it to every evaluation and refuses a configuration without it, a generation already on the volume recorded under another protocol, and any generation summary that does not carry it; it never falls back to greedy decoding

evaluation.context: 8,192 trained context; each sample generates until EOS or the context minus its prompt (AGENTS.md P18); degeneration stops are recorded, never re-scored as correct
evaluation.every_checkpoint: two PCA-Original, two D4-Original and two D4-Augmented checkpoints, each generated once under this protocol

primary_measure.what: correctness on the FORMAL static items of fluid_reasoning_720 (dev_v1): 570 items over four axes (task-contained deduction, inductive rule discovery, compositional generalization, abstract analogical); held-out rule families
primary_measure.row: one row per (arm, seed, item): correct = the formal scorer's verdict on the one nucleus sample
primary_measure.interactive: EXPLORATORY: the 144 interactive episodes are generated, scored and reported per arm and seed beside the decision, never inside it or its Holm family; h1_statistics refuses interactive rows. Why: the increment's interactive data comes from the same 3 calibration families as H1's (hidden_buttons act.reverse 17 episodes, probe_function threshold 8, digit_sum 3: 28 episodes, 153 turns), the scope rule the maintainer set for H1 on 2026-10-22

decision_rule.effect_size: the item-weighted mean of d_i, d_i = mean over the two seeds of (Y correct - X correct) on item i: an absolute difference in correctness rate, in percentage points
decision_rule.interval: two-sided 95% percentile interval, rule-family cluster bootstrap stratified by axis, 10,000 resamples; it covers item sampling and each item's sampling outcome, never training-seed variation
decision_rule.seed_aggregation: two seeds are two observations of one item (mean per item); each seed's own estimate is reported, and every directional label requires both on its side; no seed is selected or dropped
decision_rule.floor: an arm whose pooled formal static correctness is below 2% is at the floor: both arms at the floor -> NOT_RESOLVED with flag FLOOR; one arm -> flag FLOOR_<arm> beside the label; NO_GO needs neither arm at the floor; a GO off the floor is still a GO

labels.GO: the interval lies wholly above +SESOI and every seed's estimate is above +SESOI: for B, adding the fluid increment with its compute raises static fluid correctness by a meaningful amount; for A, D4 Top-1 initializes better than PCA under E1's recipe
labels.NO_GO: the interval and every seed's estimate lie inside (-SESOI, +SESOI) and neither arm is at the floor: a meaningful effect is excluded at this scale
labels.REVERSED: the interval lies wholly below -SESOI and every seed's estimate is below -SESOI: a meaningful harm
labels.INCONCLUSIVE: the evaluation resolved but the interval or a seed crosses a SESOI boundary: no decision either way, and no claim of an effect or of its absence
labels.NOT_RESOLVED: fewer than 10 discordant item-seed pairs or 5 informative clusters, a degenerate bootstrap, or both arms below 2% (flag FLOOR): the evaluation did not discriminate between the arms; no equivalence, no exclusion of a gain, no GO

decision_rule.by_axis: each static axis with SESOI 0.08 under the same rule (clusters unstratified); an axis gain counts only when its label is GO and it survives Holm

reported_beside: each fluid axis per arm and seed, and the two generator tiers (evaluation-only generators: unseen format; shared generators' held-out families: unseen rule)

every supporting and guard-rail unit of eval-set-1 on its own (math_verified, gsm8k, multihop, rag, answerability_paired, safety_paired, eval_behavior_v0 core, stage3_legacy_150 as in-sample regression only)
usable rollout and each component, natural termination, degeneration stops and context-limit hits
training loss and validation loss on E1's 16 sequences (diagnostics, never a reasoning result)
never: mixing a greedy result (E1's, H1's or any other) with a nucleus one
changing this rule, its constants, the evaluation set, the mask, the scorers or the decoding protocol after a result is seen
a pooled score across units or capabilities
selecting, dropping or adding a seed; re-running a complete valid evaluation for another draw
reading usable rollout, loss, KL or natural termination as reasoning
validated: scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/tests/test_h1pa_statistics.py: every label reachable on synthetic rows, greedy rows refused, a changed rule refused, interactive rows refused
